newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Qantas says B737 checks okay.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Qantas says B737 checks okay.

text.p: Qantas Airways Ltd said on Monday it had completed inspecting its 37 Boeing 737s in response to a recommendation from the aircraft maker to test a component of the power control unit in each aircraft's rudder system.
A Qantas spokesman told Reuters the checks found no faults in the B737 rudders.

Qantas executive general manager aircraft operations Doug Gillies said that Qantas engineers had completed the work within 48 hours of the notification from Boeing, well ahead of the 10 day compliance period.
On Friday, The Boeing Co recommended that all 737 jetliners, the world's most widely used passenger plane, be tested within 10 days for potential safety problems in the rudder systems.
